name: @tty-pt/jarvis
description: Universal Compositional Semantic Solver, Cross-Platform Intent IR, Voice Pipeline, and Xylem Environment Adapters

scripts.build:native: mkdir -p build/Release && gcc -O3 -fPIC -shared -I/usr/include/node -I../include -I../../libmm/include -I../../libxylem/include -I../../libstele/include -I../../libcorm/include native/jarvis_napi.c -L../lib -L../../libmm/lib -L../../libxylem/lib -L../../libstele/lib -L../../libcorm/lib -Wl,-rpath,'$ORIGIN/../../../lib' -Wl,-rpath,'$ORIGIN/../../../../libmm/lib' -Wl,-rpath,/usr/lib -ljarvis -lmm -lxylem -lstele -lcorm -lm -o build/Release/jarvis_node.node 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm run build:wasm

author: Paulo Quirino <quirinpa@gmail.com>
